mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.merchant_id, p.category_id, pc.name AS category_name, p.name, p.type, CASE WHEN p.type = 'PHYSICAL' THEN '实物商品' WHEN p.type = 'SERVICE' THEN '服务商品' ELSE '未知类型' END AS type_desc, p.status, CASE WHEN p.status = 'DRAFT' THEN '草稿' WHEN p.status = 'PUBLISHED' THEN '已发布' WHEN p.status = 'ARCHIVED' THEN '已归档' ELSE '未知状态' END AS status_desc, p.tags, p.description, p.main_image, p.detail_images, p.detail_description, p.attributes, p.sort_weight, COALESCE(sales_info.total_sales, 0) as total_sales, p.created_by, p.updated_by, p.created_time, p.updated_time, p.is_deleted, p.tenant_id, p.version FROM products p LEFT JOIN product_categories pc ON p.category_id = pc.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT oi.product_id, SUM(oi.quantity) as total_sales FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status IN ('PAID', 'PENDING_VERIFICATION', 'COMPLETED') AND o.is_deleted = 0 AND oi.is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY oi.product_id ) sales_info ON p.id = sales_info.product_id WHERE p.id = #{productId} AND p.is_deleted = 0
